params.message:
Remove Vera as a hand: the review door, its ticket and its words

Vera, the review product, is gone, and the gateway has not served #agent-vera
since 5 October. Portal still issued review tickets, kept operator words for
that hand and named it on the grants page.

- POST /api/ingest/capability/vera/{slug}/{review} and reviewCapability are
  removed, with Capability::issueForReview, REVIEW and REVIEW_KINDS and the
  vera agent fragment.
- OperatorKeys no longer accepts a word signed for #agent-vera; it is refused
  like any hand the gateway does not serve.
- Grants drops the "Reviews in Vera" type, the review target and the Vera
  branch in admitted(). WorkbenchAdmission drops VERA and forAct().
- History stays: the 2026_09_13_190000 migration and every admission row.
  act() still reads an old word that names an act, so it is never taken for a
  period, and a Vera row still in force reads as a past hand on
  /portal/grants (Grants::PAST_HANDS) instead of a bare fragment.
- docs/agent-doors.md keeps the dated history and loses the Vera door, its
  table row and the Vera-only open question.
- Tests: the review-ticket tests are replaced by one that a Vera word is
  refused and the door is 404, one that an old Vera row admits no one, and
  one that it renders as a past hand. The kind fixture loses review.*.
